messages:
incident-bot: Alert grouping created: `inference-latency-prod` -> 900 triggers in 4m. Auto-escalation policy will page primary and then two backups.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-9102 created for service=inference, symptom=high-500-rate. Pages sent to emma (primary). Escalation after 4m.

emma (oncall): Ack. seeing a surge of 502/504 from /v1/chat and /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Frontend latency also spikes. Suspect a regression from last night's autoscaler tweak.

raj (sre): I'm seeing a burst of identical alerts per host; seems alerts aren't deduping because source_ip tag is different and our grouping key is just alert_name. We're getting paging storms. Can someone mute duplicates so PD stops spamming phones?

nina (platform): We have an automatic short-suppress feature but it's disabled for this group. I'll apply an emergency mute for 20m at the alert-group level and leave a single PD incident active.

deploy-bot: Deploy Bot: Detected rollout activity 2h ago: autoscaler v2.3.1. Noted in deploy log `deploy:autoscaler v2.3.1 by @sre-bot`.

nina (platform): Applying suppression now:
```
incident-bot: /silence group=inference-latency-prod duration=20m reason="paging storm: duplicate host-level alerts; triage ongoing"
```

incident-bot: Silence added: group=inference-latency-prod duration=20m. Notifications for matching triggers will be suppressed. One PD incident remains active.

pagerduty: PD-9102 acknowledged by emma (oncall). Escalation timers paused.

emma (oncall): Thanks. customer impact: approx 4% request failure rate across eu-west-1; some premium customers reporting degraded responses. Need quick mitigation.

raj (sre): Quick triage: kernel OOMs on inference hosts + high swap churn. autoscaler change reduced memory headroom on new instances (smaller instance type). I'd recommend reverting autoscaler config or spinning up larger instance class. Rolling revert would take ~8m.

tom (eng): Can do a fast hotfix: revert autoscaler instance-type override in the config and trigger scale-up. Will push canary to 3 hosts first.

nina (platform): Also, I'll patch grouping to include `route` and `root_cause` tags so future identical symptoms collapse:
```
- grouping: ["alert_name"]
+ grouping: ["service","route","root_cause"]
```

raj (sre): Good. Also add a short dedupe window (auto-suppress repeated matching alerts for 30s) so we don't get multiple pages for the same event while instruments catch up.

tom (eng): Canary revert in progress...

deploy-bot: Deploy Bot: canary-revert started: autoscaler-config rollback on 3 hosts.

raj (sre): Node remediation in parallel: draining worst offenders and restarting inference service.

emma (oncall): Please keep paging suppressed while we triage, but leave the PD incident open for customer comms.

nina (platform): Noted. Suppression in place. Adding temporary PD note: "paging suppression applied; triage in progress".

incident-bot: Auto-grouper status: found root cause missing in ~12% of traces due to tracer sampling bug. Filed fix -> will include tag backfill.

tom (eng): Canary rollback looks good: error rate on canary hosts back to baseline. Proceeding to roll rollback to additional 12 hosts. ETA ~10m.

raj (sre): Early telemetry: host-level failure rates on remediated nodes down from 75rps to 3rps. Good signal.

emma (oncall): Customer impact trending down. I'll keep monitoring dashboards and prepare a short impact blurb for support.

pagerduty: PD-9102 update: investigation ongoing. Notifications suppressed per group policy.

needing_retry: I meant to react with :eyes:, ignore that line.

nina (platform): After rollback finished, I'll push grouping/dedupe changes to staging and schedule a hotfix for production grouping engine. Tracking ticket PLAT-782.

raj (sre): Note for post-incident: alert too sensitive for short bursts. Propose changing alerting rule to include sustained-window=2m and add severity tiers. Also implement automatic short suppression for identical triggers within 30s.

emma (oncall): Handing over to raj for the next shift (07:00-15:00). Key notes: reverted autoscaler instance type; suppression applied; grouping engine bug likely root cause for paging storm; customer impact reduced. Please finalize postmortem and customer comms.

raj (sre): Ack handoff. I'll draft postmortem, include timeline, actions, and the planned infra changes (grouping fix, dedupe window, alert thresholds).

incident-bot: Silence expired for group=inference-latency-prod. Notifications will resume.

emma (oncall): Closing out from my side. Will reopen if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
